title: What Suppresses Nash Equilibrium Play in Large Language Models? Mechanistic Evidence and Causal Control

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring deviations from Nash equilibria in canonical two-player strategic games (e.g., Prisoner's Dilemma, Stag Hunt) using self-play and cross-play, and applying mechanistic interpretability techniques (linear probing, logit lens, activation steering) to identify and control a late-layer cooperative override in the model's residual stream.
